title: The Donkey and the Horse
summary: A royal war horse pranced past Nasruddin's donkey, sneering: "I carry princes into battle adorned with gold!"...
full_text:
A royal war horse pranced past Nasruddin's donkey, sneering: "I carry princes into battle adorned with gold!"

"True," replied the donkey, "and you take arrows to your chest and cannonballs to your flank, while I carry sweet melons to children and sleep peacefully in the clover!"
moral: The pride of the war horse ends on the battlefield; the peace of the donkey endures.
